title: Self-serve verification and tiered recovery choices - merchant notice draft
content:
Summary:

This draft is a concise customer-facing notice that gives affected merchants a clear set of self-serve verification steps and three tiered recovery choices after the inference degradation on 2026-07-24 (regional EU routing mismatch). The goal: reduce time-to-recovery for customers who can act on tenant-side mitigations and to provide a reproducible evidence bundle when they escalate to support.

High-level impact:
- Window: 2026-07-24 03:10 UTC -> 2026-07-24 04:40 UTC (partial region blip)
- Affected surface: hosted inference (EU region) for some tenants using model variants with streaming enabled
- Symptom: truncated/partial streaming responses and occasional 'empty chunk' events; non-deterministic output ordering in multi-chunk responses
- Severity: medium for transactional workloads; low for best-effort asynchronous tasks

What you can do now (three tiered choices):

Tier 1 - Self-serve verification and safe-check (fast, no infra change)
- Purpose: confirm whether your tenant saw truncated/empty-chunk responses and gather minimal evidence for support.
- Steps:
  1) Re-run a small sample request with debug headers to capture metadata (max 10 requests). Example: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" -H "X-Redwood-Debug: true" -d '{"input": "status check"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  2) Inspect returned HTTP headers for: X-Redwood-Model-Variant, X-Redwood-Stream-Status, X-Redwood-Request-Id
  3) If any response contains "X-Redwood-Stream-Status: partial" or "empty-chunk", save those request IDs and timestamps
- Outcome: quick confirmation; no change to model pinning or routing.

Tier 2 - Temporary safe-mode (config change via dashboard or API)
- Purpose: reduce exposure to streaming reordering by switching to non-streaming/aggregated responses or a compatible model variant for up to 24 hours.
- Steps via Console: Settings -> Routes -> Select route -> Toggle "Disable streaming" -> Save
- Steps via API: POST /v1/routes/<route-id>/config with payload {"streaming_enabled": false} (contact SE if route id unknown)
- When to choose: you rely on ordered streaming output for end-user sessions and want to avoid reordering while we complete the downstream verification.

Tier 3 - Model pin + replay (operator-assisted or opt-in)
- Purpose: pin your tenant to an earlier model variant known-good (if applicable) and optionally opt-in to a replay of requests for deterministic recovery.
- Limitations: replay requires consent for reprocessing stored requests and may incur usage charges depending on plan.
- How to request: open a support ticket with the evidence bundle (see below) and include "Recovery: model-pin + replay" in the subject. Support/SE will coordinate the pin and the replay window.

Evidence bundle we ask you to attach when escalating:
- Up to 20 sample request IDs (from Tier 1) with exact UTC timestamps
- A minimal transcript / payload example that produced the truncated/empty result
- Console route id (if known) or the project/org id
- Screenshot of the header line showing X-Redwood-Stream-Status or any 4xx/5xx response during the window

Quick verification commands (examples you can paste):
- Header-enabled generative check:
  curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" -H "X-Redwood-Debug: true" -d '{"input": "verify chunk ordering"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate

- Non-streaming fall-back (test):
  curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" -d '{"input": "verify non-streaming", "streaming": false}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate

What our ops team will do in parallel:
- Confirm routing decision logs for your tenant and time window
- Surface any KV-cache eviction events correlating to the request IDs you provide
- Provide a recommended model pin version if a transient variant mismatch is found
- If you opt for replay, coordinate a scheduled window and share a verification plan and expected cost impact

Expected timeline for support-assisted recovery:
- Acknowledge ticket: within 2 business hours (for enterprise customers)
- Initial operator analysis: within 6 business hours
- Model pin or safe rollback (if agreed): within 24 hours
- Replay scheduling and completion: depends on request volume; typical small replays finish within 24-48 hours

Privacy and safety note:
- Replay requests are processed in a controlled environment with the same access controls as production endpoints. We will not expose raw tenant data outside of secure operator channels. You must provide explicit consent for any replay.

Customer-friendly FAQ snippets you can use in product notices:
- Q: Will I be billed for recovery actions?
  A: Basic verification steps are free. Model pinning is a configuration change and does not generate additional usage. Replay processing may incur usage charges per your plan; we will confirm cost estimates before executing.

- Q: How do I know the issue is resolved?
  A: We will provide a report with pre/post verification test cases (the same sample you used in Tier 1). You should see X-Redwood-Stream-Status return to "ok" and no empty-chunk markers in repeated runs.

Operator checklist to attach (internal use, include with customer ticket):
- [ ] Confirm tenant route id and org id
- [ ] Pull routing trace for 2026-07-24 03:00–05:00 UTC
- [ ] Correlate Request IDs provided by customer
- [ ] Check model variant mapping at the time of requests
- [ ] Verify whether KV-cache eviction spike occurred
- [ ] Propose model-pin candidate and test in canary environment

Appendix (examples of header values customers might see):
- X-Redwood-Stream-Status: ok | partial | empty-chunk
- X-Redwood-Model-Variant: gptx-compact-v1 | gptx-compat-v1
- X-Redwood-Request-Id: r_01F8K2XQ8MJ2Q2

Notes for messaging tone: keep language plain, avoid platform-internal jargon ("KV" may be used when included in parentheses). Lead with what customers can do in 5 minutes, then provide escalation path and guarantees.

This draft should be converted into a short Statuspage blurb (<= 300 words) plus a longer customer email for merchants with guidance above. For finalization: SE signoff + legal review for replay consent wording is required.
